name: Ring of No Quarter
body:
Aura moderate transmutation; CL 7th; Slot ring; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This ring appears to be a ring of blinking. Once activated in combat, the wearer appears immediately in front of the closest opponent. Should the wearer attempt to retreat or flee, the ring causes the wearer to appear in front of the closest opponent the following round.

Casting dimensional anchor and remove curse upon the ring allows the wearer to remove it, rendering the ring non-magical.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Magic Items ring of blinking

Identification DC 32
False Identification DC 22
